aboutTeaser.body: Independent developer in Israel — from DreamBit Apps to privacy-first Flutter apps, with original Zuli Monster illustrations in every app.

story.title: My Story
story.p1: Between 2012 and 2016, I developed mobile applications for Android and iOS as part of DreamBit Apps. During those years, I had the opportunity to work on various projects, learning the ins and outs of mobile development and creating apps that users loved.
story.p2: After a long break from active development, I've returned to pursue my passion - mobile app development. This time, I'm building apps as a hobby, driven by my love for technology and creativity.
story.p3: Today, I focus on developing smart and intuitive mobile applications that can help people in their daily lives. Each app I create is crafted with attention to detail, user experience, and innovative solutions to real-world problems.

items.question: Who is Zuki Apps?
items.answer: Zuki Apps is an independent mobile software publisher. The developer is based in Israel, previously developed Android and iOS apps as part of DreamBit Apps (2012–2016), and now ships consumer apps built with Flutter for iOS and Android.

items.question: What is zukiapps.com?
items.answer: This site is the public marketing presence for Zuki Apps: short descriptions of each app, links to the App Store and Google Play when available, support email, and links to each app’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Use. There is no user login on the website itself.

items.question: How do I contact Zuki Apps?
items.answer: For support and general inquiries, email zuki.apps.dev@gmail.com or call +972-50-6566393. The same contact details appear on the About and DSA Compliance pages and in store listings where applicable.

items.question: Where can I read privacy policies and terms?
items.answer: Each app has its own pages: open the app’s section on this site and follow Privacy Policy and Terms of Use. EU Digital Services Act (DSA) trader information is on the DSA Compliance page. A legacy DreamBit archive is also linked from the footer.

items.question: Which apps are listed on this site?
items.answer: The home page showcases multiple titles (for example ZuList, Hush Gallery, games, utilities, Track Ledger, Noise Meter — Shusher, Paratrooper Blitz, and others). Use the app tiles to open each product page for details and policies.

items.question: Is there a public API documented here?
items.answer: No. This website does not document a public REST or GraphQL API for end users. Apps use their own clients on the device and normal app-store distribution.

about.title: About Zuki Apps
about.subtitle: Independent mobile developer — iOS & Android
about.p1: Zuki Apps is an independent mobile software studio based in Israel. We ship practical, privacy-conscious apps for everyday life — private photo vaults, hands-free cameras, shared shopping lists, fitness timers, trivia games, and developer tools.
about.p2: Every app is built with Flutter for a consistent experience on iPhone, iPad, and Android. We favor on-device processing, clear privacy policies, and no-account flows where possible.
about.p3: Between 2012 and 2016, our apps shipped under DreamBit Apps. Today the Zuki Apps catalog continues that craft with new titles and long-term support for existing users.
about.catalogBody: Browse all product pages, support, and policies from the home page or our machine-readable catalog at /site-facts.json.

accessibility.metaDescription: Accessibility statement for zukiapps.com: keyboard access, screen readers, contact for barriers, alignment with WCAG 2.1 Level AA aims.
accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.subtitle: Zuki Apps website (zukiapps.com)

s1.title: Our commitment
s1.body:
Zuki Apps aims to make this marketing website usable by as many people as possible, including people who use keyboards, screen readers, magnification, and reduced-motion preferences.

We work toward the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA. This site is a brochure / catalog site (no user accounts on the website itself).

s2.title: Measures we take
s2.body:
• Skip link to jump to main content
• Semantic headings and landmarks where practical
• Text alternatives for meaningful images
• Visible focus styles for keyboard users
• Respect for prefers-reduced-motion
• RTL layout support for Hebrew and Arabic
• Analytics cookies only after optional consent

s3.title: Known limitations
s3.body:
• Some product pages include rich carousels or decorative motion that may still be imperfect with assistive technology
• Third-party store badges and embeds are controlled by Apple / Google and may not meet the same standard
• Older archive pages (DreamBit legacy) prioritize historical listings and may be simpler or uneven

We improve issues as we find them.

s4.title: Compatibility
s4.body: The site is designed to work with current versions of major browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge) and common assistive technologies on desktop and mobile. We recommend keeping your browser and OS up to date.

s5.title: Standards
s5.body: This statement is informed by WCAG 2.1 and, for visitors in Israel, the spirit of Israeli Standard SI 5568 (based on WCAG 2.0 AA). Full formal conformance auditing is ongoing; this page describes our practical approach and how to report barriers.

contact.title: Report an accessibility barrier
contact.body: If you encounter a barrier on zukiapps.com, email or call us. Please include the page URL and what you were trying to do. We will do our best to help.

sitePrivacy.title: Website privacy
sitePrivacy.subtitle: zukiapps.com

s1.title: Scope
s1.body: This notice covers the public marketing website zukiapps.com (including locale paths). Each mobile app has its own Privacy Policy linked from that app’s product page.

s2.title: What we collect on the website
s2.body:
• No account or login on this website
• Optional Google Analytics only after you accept cookies (you can reject)
• If you email or call us, we process the contact details you send in order to reply
• Server or CDN logs may include standard technical data (IP, user agent) for security and reliability

s3.title: Cookies & analytics
s3.body: Non-essential analytics cookies load only after Accept on the cookie banner. Reject keeps the site fully usable. You can clear site data in your browser to reset the choice.

s4.title: App privacy policies
s4.body: For data practices inside each app (camera, lists, location, ads SDKs, and so on), open that app’s page on this site and read its Privacy Policy.

s5.title: Contact
s5.body: Questions about this website’s privacy: zuki.apps.dev@gmail.com or +972-50-6566393.
